sentences.text: 2. The application was opposed on the ground that sufficient ground was not stated for condoning the delay.
3. The petitioners filed the above appeal claiming enhancement of compensation in respect of injuries sustained in a motor vehicle accident.

Considering the fact that this appeal related to claim for compensation under the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act, I hold that the delay of 538 days in filing the appeal can be condoned on condition that the petitioner shall waive the interest for the enhanced amount of compensation awarded, if any, for the period of delay in filing the appeal.
4. In the result, this application is allowed on condition that the petitioners will not be eligible for interest for the enhanced amount of compensation, if any, in appeal.
The learned Standing Counsel takes notice for the 2 nd respondent.
Policy is admitted, hence notice to the 1st respondent is dispensed with.
The learned counsel for the appellant is directed to serve a copy of the appeal memorandum to the learned Standing Counsel.
Post after two months for settlement.

Sd/-
C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, JUDGE SMA 07-02-2025 /True Copy/
